description: Implementation of a thread class for handling analog thumbstick input on UWP platform, including input state updates and event firing.

classes.name: AnalogThumbstickThread::Impl
classes.description: Private implementation class for handling thumbstick input processing and threading.

methods.name: AnalogThumbstickThread::Impl::Run
methods.description: Main loop that updates thumbstick state at approximately 120Hz.

methods.name: AnalogThumbstickThread::Impl::Update
methods.description: Reads thumbstick states and fires events if necessary.

methods.name: AnalogThumbstickThread::Impl::FireEventIfNecessary
methods.description: Fires joystick update events when thumbstick positions change.

methods.name: AnalogThumbstickThread::Impl::GetCombinedThumbStickState
methods.description: Aggregates thumbstick states from multiple gamepads.

methods.name: ClampToZeroOne
methods.description: Clamps a float value between -1.0 and 1.0.
